about.title: Sand Springs' Local Market
about.subtitle: For nearly four decades, Red Barn Western Market has been the trusted local source for lumber, feed, hardware, building materials, and more in Sand Springs, Oklahoma.
about.storyBody: Red Barn Western Market has been a cornerstone of Sand Springs, Oklahoma since 1987. What started as a small feed and farm supply store has grown into a full-service western market — meeting every family from first ranch hands to lifelong contractors. We carry what is in season, only what works. Customers respect to us for honest answers, fair priced equipment, and the easiest checkout in town. Built in 1987, in Sand Springs, our location in Tulsa County, Oklahoma still anchors the same Red Barn we always built — that we hire local and stock from those that we know to keep our promise.
about.value1Body: Every item on our shelves is hand‑selected and tested before earning its place.
about.value2Body: No surprises. We negotiate hard with vendors so you get the best price possible.
about.value3Body: From lumber and building to mobile parts and plumbing — we have everything for your build.
about.value4Body: Family‑owned, Sand Springs‑rooted, and serving Tulsa Country. Drop in. Meet us at the counter.
about.value5Body: Talk to a real human — not a call‑center — for advice on tools, materials, projects.
about.value6Body: We are a local business rooted in Sand Springs, OK. We support and serve the community every day.
about.milestone1987: Red Barn opens its doors in Sand Springs, OK — selling the best community has feed, hardware, and basic ranch tools.
about.milestone1995: Expansion adds lumber section. Becomes a one‑stop building materials supply source.
about.milestone2005: Added flooring, paint, and railroad ties to the inventory — becoming a full lumber & contractor supply source.
about.milestone2015: Hardware and tool dimensions doubled in size. Serving contractors and homeowners across Tulsa County.
about.milestone2020: Launched online ordering for local pickup and expanded delivery to surrounding counties.
about.milestoneToday: Full e‑commerce experience launches — shop Lumber, Feed, Hardware, and more for 4+ counties.
about.team1Body: Two‑decade Red Barn vet who can hand‑measure a board with one glance and still tell you a great story.
about.team2Body: Sources what we sell from across the West, ensures all Red Barn stock is the best of the lot.
about.team3Body: Fast‑moving Dylan runs the yard and the warehouse, keeping orders on the truck and the trail.
about.team4Body: Greets all callers, all walk‑ins, and the regulars by first name. Nora keeps the front of house warm.
